milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'cliff' is a custom terrain feature (large stone mass at ~12-20, y0-10, z12-20) that must be visually identified. The player must navigate close enough and face the cliff center. Max_distance=12 prevents overlap with the packed_ice milestone while still being reachable given the cliff's large visible profile. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the formation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the packed ice is a 5x5 patch of blue blocks at the cliff's base (relative coords ~7-11, y0, z13-17) that must be visually located. Target is the patch center (9,0,15). Max_distance=8 requires the player to walk close enough to clearly identify the blue ice blocks. The facing requirement ensures the player is actually observing the ice, not just passing nearby.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the stone slab path is a diagonal line of 12 slabs that must be visually identified. Target is slab at (3,0,9) — chosen slightly further from spawn than the path midpoint so that max_distance=6 prevents accidental satisfaction from spawn (spawn-to-target distance ≈ 9.5 blocks, well beyond threshold). Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the slab path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the iron door is a specific block on the north face of the stone brick building at (-5, 1, 0) that must be visually located. Max_distance=5 requires close approach to the building entrance. The door faces north (toward positive z), so the player approaching from the slab path direction will see it directly. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the door, not just standing near the building.
